text:
Alex: Heads up — main CI just flipped red after a merge. deploy-check -> smoke/gateway tests failing :warning:
Jamal: I see it too. Failing test: `tests/gateway/test_connection.py::test_timeout_handling`. Build: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/2940001234
ci-bot: [alert] job deploy-check failed (exit 1) — see logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/logs/2940001234
Alex: Error excerpt?
Lina: Quick paste from the failing test run:
```
E   AssertionError: expected 200 but got 503
requests.exceptions.HTTPError: 503 Service Unavailable
  File "tests/gateway/test_connection.py", line 56, in test_timeout_handling
    resp = client.get('/health')
```
Maria: Hmm, 503 from the gateway. The merge 8a7f2b7 touched proxy/timeout defaults (PR #2345). Could be related.
Jamal: @Lina @Maria who owns the gateway infra change? We need a quick triage or bisect.
Lina: I can take a look. Pulling the full container logs now. If it's envoy upstream reset it could be a config flip.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by Lina — queued as build 2940001235
Lina: Rerun completed and... still failing, same assertion.
Maria: From container logs:
```
[2026-03-17T12:03:21Z] envoy upstream reset: connection refused to 10.0.7.12:8080
[2026-03-17T12:03:21Z] proxy: healthcheck failed, status=503
```
Lina: That upstream IP belongs to the new sidecar proxy introduced in the merge. I suspect PROXY_IDLE_TIMEOUT was lowered from 30s to 1s in that diff.
Alex: If revert fixes it we should roll back to keep main green. Can someone open a revert?
Maria: I'll open a revert PR now and tag it urgent. https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/commit/revert-8a7f2b7
Jamal: Also please add flaky marker for that test in the interim and a follow-up to add an integration guard.
ops-bot: Canary rollback will be triggered automatically if revert merges to main (policy: immediate).
Lina: I've attached a quick patch locally setting PROXY_IDLE_TIMEOUT back to 30s; running a local smoke — passes.
Alex: Great. Thanks all. Keep updates in this thread; if revert merges and CI goes green ping here and close the loop. :thumbsup:
